meta_description:
3,314 likes, 14 comments - yog_with_soni on October 4, 2026: "If your legs feel heavy, achy, or swollen by the end of the day, don’t ignore it. It could be due to varicose veins.

These simple movements won’t make varicose veins disappear, but they can help manage discomfort and support healthier circulation.

✨ How they help:
• Activate the calf muscles, which act as a “second heart” to pump blood back towards the heart.
• Improve blood circulation and reduce blood pooling in the legs.
• Ease stiffness, heaviness, and mild swelling.
• Keep the ankles and feet mobile, especially if you sit or stand for long hours.

Even 5–10 minutes of gentle movement every day can make your legs feel lighter and more comfortable.

⚠️ Disclaimer: These exercises are meant to support circulation and help manage symptoms. They are not a replacement for medical treatment. If you have severe pain, significant swelling, skin changes, ulcers, or worsening varicose veins, consult a qualified healthcare professional for proper evaluation and treatment.

Save this for days when your legs need a little extra care. 🦵✨

#vericoseveins #yogaeveryday #yogapractice #yogaforeveryone #vericose".
